text_block_list.text:
Transcend got injured during training, so 
I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trai-chan. But don't you worry 
your pretty little head.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: See, just like that~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
See? It doesn't even hurt that much. Let's 
head back and try out some new training.
choice_data_list:
Even so, I want you to play it safe and 
get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. Well, if you put it that way, 
guess I got no choice.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trai-chan, you love me to bits, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Like your worried face when I got 
injured... Or how you stay by my side the 
whole time and take such good care of me, 
maybe?
choice_data_list:
I-I'm trying to have a serious 
conversation here, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! My bad, my bad. I promise I'll get 
proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And with Trainer-chan's reaction just now, 
I won't be bored for a while, right~?

And so, Transcend made sure to get a 
proper amount of rest...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Okay, Trainie! That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well then, back to the track—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "...Wait! Owwie...!?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like this was even worse than we 
thought. Really."

Transcend ended up hurting her leg even 
more and couldn't return to training.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: One, two. One, two.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mm, no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey. If this were a video game, you 
know—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Transcend trained carefully and properly, 
making a smooth and successful comeback!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, is that really something to display 
proudly...?

Transcend trained carefully and 
appropriately, making a smooth and 
successful comeback!
